project.name: osgi/domains/incus/incus-port
project.description: The incus domain's seam — both contacts toward an Incus host (an instance needs an image, one concern). IncusInstanceContact (is a launched instance reachable, checked by running a trivial command on it) + its flat IncusExecRequest; and ImageBuilder (build the seed image's distrobuilder artifacts, plus recipeDigest so the host folds the edge-owned recipe into its cache key) + its flat ImageBuildRequest and ImageBuildException. The incus-edge satisfies both by shelling `ssh … incus exec` / `distrobuilder build-incus`; the host keeps the readiness orchestration and the Pulumi Image resource + cache. type=seam: system-exported, one shared copy across the host↔bundle boundary, like every -port.
